said.text: Still: you’re spent by the second half: find where the play lets you breathe. You tried play the second half measured: 52.6 then, 48.4 now, which made it worse: worth knowing, and not the answer.

said.speaker: school
said.title: The Director’s Note: Carlotta Festival Of New Plays
said.text: Solid, sound nights. The next step is to take more risks in them. Work on your presence: it held your nights back most.

said.speaker: school
said.title: Looking Back: Carlotta Festival Of New Plays
said.text: Carlotta Festival Of New Plays: you answered all 12 calls. The director gave you five notes, and you took four. You worked on one more, but it didn’t move. The dress rehearsal was solid. With the company, your nights averaged 57 out of 100. What’s still open goes with you into class. (A summary of your run, not the director’s own words.)

said.speaker: school
said.title: The Summer Is Yours
said.text: Classes are done until the fall term, and nothing at the School calls on you until then.
